title: An Industry Perspective on Software Vulnerability Management: A Systematic Review of Approaches, Tools, Practices, and Challenges
abstract: arXiv:2611.23267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software vulnerability management (SVM) refers to coordinated activities to detect, assess, repair, and disclose software vulnerabilities (SVs) across a product or ecosystem. As software systems grow in scale and dependency depth, organisations must balance timely security action with limited expertise, evolving tooling, and delivery pressure. In this practitioner-centred systematic literature review, we synthesise 57 peer-reviewed empirical studies published between 2010 and 2025 that collect primary data directly from industry practitioners. We examine the SVM solutions (approaches, tools, and practices) proposed and evaluated with practitioners and the challenges practitioners report when adopting and using these solutions in real-world settings. We find that practice-oriented contributions, such as guidelines, recommendations, lessons learned, and shared experiences, constitute most of the evidence base, while fewer studies evaluate

translated_title: 软件漏洞管理的行业视角：方法、工具、实践与挑战的系统性综述
translated_abstract: 软件漏洞管理（SVM）是指在产品或生态系统中对软件漏洞（SV）进行检测、评估、修复和披露的协调性活动。随着软件系统规模和依赖深度的不断增长，组织必须在有限的专业知识、不断演变的工具和交付压力之间权衡及时的安全行动。在这项以从业者为中心的系统性文献综述中，我们综合了2010年至2025年间发表的57篇同行评审实证研究，这些研究均直接从行业从业者那里收集原始数据。我们考察了与从业者共同提出和评估的SVM解决方案（方法、工具和实践），以及从业者在真实环境中采用和使用这些解决方案时所报告的挑战。我们发现，面向实践的贡献，如指南、建议、经验教训和经验分享，构成了证据基础的主体，而对其有效性进行评估的研究相对较少。
tldr: 该系统性综述分析了57项直接涉及行业从业者的实证研究，总结了软件漏洞管理领域的方法、工具与实践及其实施挑战，发现现有证据以指南、经验教训等实践导向贡献为主，而严格的评估性研究较为缺乏。
